about.title: About Fresno Unified Calendar Dates
about.content: This page summarizes districtwide dates from Fresno Unified's official academic calendar. School-specific testing, athletics, bell schedules, graduation details, transportation notices, and same-day announcements may be published separately by individual schools or the district.

planningTips.title: Fresno Unified Calendar Notes
content: District Buyback Days are non-student days listed on the official academic calendar.
Use Fresno Unified's official calendar page for revised PDFs and school communications for campus-specific changes.
The downloadable calendar file is a one-time import and will not update automatically if FUSD changes a date.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Fresno Unified calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use Fresno Unified's official calendar page and messages from your child's school for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Fresno Unified School District.

compareIntro: Compare Fresno Unified with other California districts using the same source-based fields: first day, last day, and major break dates. Each district's official calendar remains the final source.
